entry_state: The connected insurance groups reach the same final cash under histories with different recognition timing, while improper pooling hides losses. Complete event publication preserves group components and exact retries. PAA eligibility, acquisition-cost treatment, claim settlement and finance have distinct clocks; reinsurance and direct participation require their own contractual conditions. The next case values a participating guarantee.
exit_state: The participating floor is priced by replication separately from physical mortality and market probabilities. Its service and settlement histories retain loss components and investment cash separately. Variable-fee changes, risk mitigation, partial treaty coverage, loss revisions and legal modifications have distinct causes. Replacement-contract valuation and later finance treatment remain to be developed.
findings: Market-consistent guarantee value 9 differs from the physical expected top-up 4.5 under the explicit two-state assumptions.
Covered-contract allocation precedes the treaty percentage; the held loss-recovery component is inside the asset.

The discussion completing subsection 12.8.2 appears on page 290. Its premature span and the parent section span from segment 284–289 require a supplemental review-record correction. No manuscript defect is implied.
